Reasoning: The stem states that m and n are on the same meridian and that their latitude difference is 90°. On October 1, the subsolar point is located in the Southern Hemisphere. Combining the northernmost point m of the twilight line a with n, which is 90° directly below it, it can be determined that n is the subsolar point. Therefore, the meridian where point m is located is the meridian where the subsolar point is located. At this time, Beijing time is 19:00 on October 1, 2013. Beijing time is the zone time of the East Eighth Zone, namely UTC+8, so Universal Time is 19:00 - 8 hours = 11:00. The local time on the meridian where the subsolar point is located is 12:00, which is 1 hour earlier than Greenwich time 11:00; the longitude difference is 15°, and an earlier time corresponds to east longitude, so this meridian is 15°E.
